1000 pacific st|06902.name: Allure @ Harbor Point
1000 pacific st|06902.summary: Allure @ Harbor Point residents praise the well-maintained building, luxury finishes, top-tier appliances, and excellent soundproofing. The waterfront location offers beautiful views in a safe, walkable area. Staff like Sebastian Lopez, Dalone, and leasing agents receive high marks for helpfulness. However, some note issues with package handling, inconsistent concierge service, tight garage spaces, and lack of buzzer system at south entrance.

reviews.name: Viviana Shanks
reviews.body: The Allure is a dream! Everything has been well designed and thought, the team is awesome and extremely helpful. One part of the building is still under construction but everything is spotless clean, and all brand new. The appliances are Luxurious and functional. The common areas are very upper class and always clean. Neighbors are great and polite. The building is ideally located by the water and the views are fantastic! It really feels like a luxurious building and we love it! Totally recommend!

response.body: Hi Viviana !! We are very happy to have provided you with such a positive experience! Your recommendation means so much to us and we're so happy to have earned it. Thank you again for taking the time to let the world know about your positive experience. Have a great day! We hope to see you soon!

reviews.name: Jason Estrella
reviews.body: If you’re gonna rent an apartment in this complex, you have to work with Jordan absolutely took care of everything and just such a nice and hard-working. Individual made the entire experience Extremely easy

response.body: Thanks for the glowing review, Jason! We're happy to hear Jordan provided top-notch service, making your experience seamless. We're committed to maintaining this level of excellence for you. Looking forward to exceeding your expectations in the future!

reviews.name: Nancy Howard
reviews.body: I have high praise for Dalone at Allure.  He was incredibly helpful in coordinating moving furniture from an apartment in Allure to NV.  He was able to secure loading dock and elevators in both buildings for the same time slot- making a complicated move a reality.  The best!

response.body: Thanks, Nancy! We're thrilled to hear about your positive experience with Dalone at Allure. We're delighted to have assisted with your move seamlessly. Looking forward to continuing to provide top-notch service. Here's to more great moments at Allure!

reviews.name: joel felicio
reviews.body: When searching for an apartment at Allure I was working with Wes Kuehner. I explained to him what my wish list was and he listened attentively and delivered a unit to our liking. Wes is attentive, patient and super friendly. now after living in Allure for over a year i can say overall its a great experience. The building is in a prime location in a really nice walkable and safe neighborhood with views of the water. We love walking our dog here much better than when we lived downtown which was traffic ridden, dirty and filled with some sketchy people. The units are really nice inside with high quality finishes. If ever a problem maintenance is very quick to come and fix it.  The garage door has always worked for us so not sure why I read that it doesn't work some time. I do feel that the garage was designed a bit tight and it is not so easy to pull in and out of your spot but its not the end of the world either. it is out of the buildings control but people do drive a bit too fast in the garage and with so many children and pets possibly walking around its only a matter of time before an accident happens. I would suggest the building install more speed bumps. Another area that needs improvements that if you live at the south building there is no staff concierge at the entrance and so when you order a food delivery they have no way to get inside the building. This is a problem. If they don't want to staff a concierge person at this entrance  I don't understand why they don't have a system in place where tenants can buzz people at the door entrance in. We had this option when we lived at Atlantic Station and this was a great feature when the concierge was not at the desk.  For us the  biggest areas that need improvement are the concierge people at the front desk and the way packages are handled. We have lived in 2 other buildings in Stamford and our experience with the front desk concierge were so friendly and helpful. That is unfortunately not true at Allure. The people staffed at the front desk are cold, seemingly uninterested in helping you and can easily cop an attitude when you need something.  It seems maybe they are underpaid and not happy to do this job. Either that or they are not trained correctly. And yes as other people have mentioned getting packages at this building is a complete sh!t show. I still don't understand how its supposed to work and not sure why packages are constantly getting lost. This was never a problem at the other buildings we lived in. Allure seems to lack a proper system when it comes to getting packages to tenants. Still for us while there is room for improvement we do love living at Allure and if you ever consider moving here ask to work with Wes!

response.body: Thanks, Joel for sharing your wonderful experience at Allure! We're overjoyed that Wes provided exceptional service, and you love the prime location and high-quality finishes. We appreciate your valuable feedback on areas for improvement and will work diligently to enhance our concierge services and package handling. Looking forward to continuing to exceed your expectations!

reviews.name: TAKIDA JOSEPH H
reviews.body:
It’s my second time going in to the welcome center. This time I needed  to clarify some information.  I met Dario Torregiane he was so helpful and clear, professional and  he even took a little sticky pad and drew it out for me. I had a lot of questions , he explained until I understood very patiently. Also he took us to see the apartment.  He convinced us to see a unit I didn’t like before, he explained the lay out and now I’m in love with that one I didn’t like. Amazing job and can’t wait to get in so soon. The gym the amenities very worth it.

When you go to the welcome center ask for Dario, easy to communicate with and very patient I appreciated the service very much.
This is the beautiful view from the unit I love

response.body: Thank you so much for your stellar rating and detailed feedback, Joseph! We're so glad to know how helpful Dario was in explaining the unit layout as well as the gym and other amenities. If you have any questions or concerns at all, please reach out to us. We're glad to help!

reviews.name: harris may
reviews.body:
For four years, my wife and I have called the Allure Apartments at Harbor Point our home. The dedicated team at BLT ensures that our building remains in great condition.

Elira Krasnigi, the Assistant General Manager, particularly stands out. Always greeting my wife and I with a warm smile, Elira goes above and beyond to accommodate any needs we may have.
In short, Elira and the Allure Apartments are top-notch. They both receive a resounding A from our family.

Harris May

response.body: Thanks for your kind words, Harris! We're thrilled to hear that you and your wife have enjoyed your time at Allure Apartments. Elira truly exemplifies our commitment to exceptional service. We always strive to exceed your expectations and look forward to continuing to provide you with a top-notch living experience.

reviews.name: Ira Kerner
reviews.body: The Allure building is maintained very well. Very clean, both in and out of the apartments. The units themselves are very well appointed. Top of the line appliances. Walls are insulated, so it is very unlikely one would hear anything from a neighboring unit. Amenities are exceptional. Staff is extremely friendly and eager to help in any way they can.  Repairs and maintenance are addressed asap by a very skilled team. Special shout out to Sebastian Lopez, the Senior General Manager of BLT's Harbor Point residential leasing and operations. An outstanding manager who is genuinely interested in the tenants, and making sure that everyone has a good experience as a resident here. He is very accessible and available to ensure the perfect quality of life living in Harbor Point. I would move here all over again!!

response.body: Thank you so much for your stellar rating and wonderful comments, Ira. We're so glad to know how much you are enjoying your home here at Allure and that you find the amenities and the staff exceptional! We'll be sure to share your shout-out with Sebastian as well. If you have any questions or concerns at all, please reach out to us.

reviews.name: Jessica Fuller
reviews.body: We want to send a special thanks to Sebastian Lopez and his team for all their hard work! We have lived in Allure for 2 1/2 years and whenever we need anything they are here for us! Abanto and Roy with Maintenance are the absolute best too! Thank you all for making us feel at home.

response.body: We appreciate your kind words, Jessica! It's wonderful to hear that Sebastian, Abanto, Roy, and the team have made your stay at Allure feel like home. We're thrilled to have you as part of our community and look forward to continuing to provide you with a top-notch living experience.

pet_policy.description: Dogs over 40 lbs. extra | Restrictions: None

743 passaic ave|07012.summary: AVE Clifton residents praise the friendly, accommodating staff and excellent service with 24-hour maintenance response. They love the convenient location near groceries, train station, and Manhattan express bus, plus amenities like gym, pool, garage parking, and package service. Opinions differ on parking assignments and noise between floors.

reviews.name: Natalia Lais
reviews.body:
Update after 18 month living in Ave:

We have lived in the Ave for 16 months and we more than happy to call it our home! The apartment complex has everything we needed: spacious, clean and well equipped apartments, fitness center, pool, mail service, fast WiFi, garage parking, community events. The community is super nice and the location is very convenient.
Everybody in a team is super friendly, accommodating, always smiling and ready to help! From the day we moved in we felt very welcomed and comfortable. The team is amazing, they take really good care about the community and the residents, it’s always clean, all the maintenance requests are always professionally solved within 24 hours. Various community events create the feeling of united community and a family.
It’s always a joy to communicate with Lyndsey, Lesley, Colleen, Valentina , they all create a wonderful, welcoming atmosphere in the community and take care about the residents! Thank you for creating this feeling of HOME and all your efforts and work!
We will miss every one of you!

Ave Clifton is a beautiful community! The location is just perfect, it is safe and quiet. The property is great, there is everything we need: spacious, clean and well equipped apartments, fitness center, pool, mail service, fast WiFi, garage parking, community events. The community is also pet friendly.
Everybody in a team is super friendly, accommodating, always smiling and ready to help! From the day we moved in we are feeling very welcomed and comfortable.
It’s just a pleasure to communicate with Lyndsey Jordan, Lesley Charles, Colleen, Valentina and Ashley, they all create a wonderful, welcoming atmosphere in the community!
From the day we arrived we are enjoying living here and never regret we chose Ave Clifton to be our home!

response.body:
Hi Natalia,

You made the entire team of AVE Clifton smile with your review. We are so happy to have you as a new member of our community. It is our pleasure to accommodate you in your new home!

reviews.name: Dr. Erdal OZKAYA
reviews.body:
Home far away :)
Great , luxurious place to live in NY.

So far 5 star experience , everything is build / designed to make us the customers / residences happy !

Easy parking ,
Really great staff , helpful whenever asked
Good gym area , very decent size , with lots of sports equipments

Pool is bit small but does the job, the pool surroundings is designed well

They accept Amazon / delivery packets on your behalf , and store it security , really nice

It's always clean

One down site is , if you are in level 1 or 2 , and have a loud upper level neighbor, you can for sure hear their steps , and as I said if they are loud , this can be bit inconvenience, but again it all depends on your neighbor

response.body: Welcome to AVE Clifton, Dr. Ozkaya!  We are so happy you chose AVE!  Thank you for taking the time to share your review!

reviews.name: Jonathan
reviews.body: We have lived at the AVE for a number of months and been impressed with the staff, the amenities, and the responsiveness. When we had maintenance issues- they were addressed within 24 hours (as in fixed), and always with great communication and support. Great location as well. Easy living, but elevated.

response.body:
Hi Jonathan, 
It has been our pleasure to have you and your family stay with us the past couple of months. We really appreciate your positive feedback! We also love having George stop by the front desk for his treats. 
- AVE Clifton Team

reviews.name: Shevy A
reviews.body: It’s a nice place to live. They keep it clean and the grounds are nice. The package system is efficient and theres a garage. I do wish they offered the option to pay for a specific space but they don’t…even though each parking space has a number. It’s annoying because I would pay more for one closer to my side’s elevator and not near a beam because I already smashed my car on one of them and scratched another. Lol. You can’t see them when pulling out backwards so you have to park backing in to a spot instead (so you can use the backup camera). But otherwise it’s great. Staff are also really nice and they know all their residents.

response.body:
Hi Shevy, 

Thank you for choosing AVE Clifton as your home and for your complimentary words about our community and team! We are sad to hear about your experience with the garage, but your feedback is important to help us improve. Our Regional Director Lyndsey would love an opportunity to connect with you to learn more. We encourage you to reach out at your convenience by calling 973.859.3200 or emailing ljordan@aveliving.com.

Sincerely, 
Your AVE Team

reviews.name: Phong Trang Tran Thanh
reviews.body:
Good service very friendly staff and they usually organize lots of fun activities. Very convenient location to Groceries and Train station. There is also an express bus going to Manhattan just nearby.
Will stay here again for my business trip.

response.body: Phong, thank you for your kind words! We're delighted to hear that you had a great experience with our community and friendly team. It's fantastic to know you enjoyed the resident events and found the nearby grocery stores and transportation options convenient. We look forward to welcoming you back on your next business trip. Safe travels!

reviews.name: Nurdin Riyanto
reviews.body:
Three months (Aug - Nov 2018) stayed here was a very beautiful moment & memorable, muffin - fruits - tea/coffee in the mornings, this apartment was so nice and easy to access.
I will visit again someday hopefully.

response.body: Nurdin, thank you so much for your positive review! We are so appreciative of your kind words. We hope to see you again very soon!

reviews.name: Avi Kaufman
reviews.body:
We highly recommend staying at the Ave. We lived there for a while and it felt like living in a hotel! When we moved in the apartment was spotless, appliances brand new and the facilities are always clean. The gym is spacious and well equipped.

All of the staff are friendly and accommodating.
Special shout out to Colleen, Valentina, Henry, and Lesley who are always available to help with a smile.

We look forward to our next stay.

response.body: Hi Avi!  Thank you for the amazing review and for highlighting our rockstar staff members! Hearing that you enjoyed your time here with us means so much. You and the family are truly missed!

reviews.name: Amanda Jiménez
reviews.body: I recently called here very last minute to get a tour, when there was no available time slots online. The leasing office was amazing and so accommodating, helping us get a tour in a matter of minutes from when I called. Highly reccomend looking here if you need a place to stay in the Montclair area. The service was amazing and the staff was so friendly! Jeanette was so hospitable and helpful.

response.body: Amanda, thank you so much for your glowing review! Your kind words and recommendation mean the world to our team.
